t: Re Labour Trouble At Foo Foong Flour Mill, 126 Mokanshan Road, Shanghai. 1St Accused Tsang Fah Hwa

pages.en:
Misc. File No. 119/37.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Pootoo Road Station, 50/3
REPORT
Date. 15.9.37. No. 19/ "B" )
Subject State of Pootoo Road Police District.
Made by D.S.I. Burton. Forwarded by Inspt. i/c.

Sir,
Between 9.30 am and 10.30 am on the 14.9.37, 80 casual labourers of the Foo Foong Flour Mill, 126 Mokanshan Road staged a riot in the mill premises, after having gathered together in a temporary godown. The trouble arose over the labourers demanding a Bonus of 10 months wages each man when temporarily suspended by the management. They had been offered a full months wages for the current month plus $2.00 but refused to accept same and would not listen to any proposal other than 10 months wages. In order to protect life and property Tear Gas bombs had to be used to eject them from the godown, after they had made repeated attacks on Police and members of Russian Regiment from their stronghold. 57 men were arrested 25 of whom received slight injuries, they are charged with offences against public order. (See P.Rd. F.I.R.441/37)
No other untoward incident occurred during the 24 hours ending 7 a.m. on the 15.9.37.
Necessary precautions are still being maintained for the protection of life and property.
District remains quiet.

D.D.O. "B" Division. D.S.I.

报告
日期：1937年9月15日。编号：19/ "B" )
事由：普陀路警区状况。
由副督察长伯顿（Burton）呈报。经主管督察转呈。

先生，
1937年9月14日上午9时30分至10时30分之间，莫干山路126号福丰面粉厂（Foo Foong Flour Mill）的80名临时工人在聚集于一个临时仓库后，在厂区内发动骚乱。事端起因于工人们要求在被资方暂时停职期间，每人发放相当于10个月工资的奖金。资方曾提出支付当月全额工资外加2.00美元，但工人拒绝接受，且除10个月工资外，不愿听取任何其他提议。为保护生命和财产，在工人们从其据点反复袭击警察及俄国团（Russian Regiment）成员后，不得不使用催泪瓦斯弹将其逐出仓库。57人被捕，其中25人受轻伤，他们被控犯有妨害治安罪。（见普陀路首次调查报告 P.Rd. F.I.R.441/37）
在截至1937年9月15日上午7时的24小时内，未发生其他意外事件。
为保护生命和财产，必要的预防措施仍在维持中。
本警区保持平静。

"B"分区副总监。副督察长。

pages.en:
At 9.30 a.m. on the 14.9.37, a telephone message was
received from the Foo Foong Flour Mill, No. 126 Mokanshan Road
to the effect that a number of coolies were creating a disturbance
in the compound of the above mill and refused to leave when
requested to do so by the management who asked for Police
assistance.

Immediately following receipt of the message a party of
Police under the officer i/c proceeded to the mill, where upon
arrival information was supplied by the management that approx.
80 casual labourers had gathered together in the hollow centre of a
60 foot temporary godown, built of rattan matting in which sacks
of bran was stacked, in each side and end of which spaces had
been left open, to form doors giving access to the interior.

Enquiries were made as to the reason for the labourers
causing disturbances and gathering together in the temporary
godown and the following ascertained.

The Foo Foong Company operate 4 flour mills in Shanghai,
two being in the Settlement and two in Chinese territory. Due to
the present hostilities, the mills in Chinese territory are not
operating and the workers of these mills have been employed in
the two mills in the Settlement namely the Foo Foong No. 126
Mokanshan Road and the Sing Dah Foo Kee, No. 10-12 Macao Road, of
these workers from the closed mills a number were casual employees
were drafted to the two mills in the settlement, where operations
have continued throughout the period of hostilities, their work
consisting chiefly of sweeping up wheat etc which drops from sacks
when being moved from place to place.

These 80 labourers have been employed by the Foo Foong
Company in the above capacity from day to day for the past 14
months, and receiving wages at the rate of 50 cents per day, paid
monthly, out of which they purchase food from the mill, which
costs them 15 cents per day.

There is not sufficient work for these labourers
at the present time and on the 12.9.37, the management decided
pages.zh:
1937年9月14日上午9时30分，接到来自莫干山路126号福丰面粉厂的电话消息，称有一群苦力在上述面粉厂的院落内制造骚乱，并拒绝在资方要求离开时离去，资方请求警方协助。

收到消息后，由主管警官率领的一队警察立即前往该厂，到达后从资方处获悉，约80名临时工人聚集在一个用竹席搭建的60英尺长的临时仓库的中心空洞处，仓库两侧和两端堆放着麸皮袋，并在两侧和端部留有开口作为门，以便进入内部。

经查询工人制造骚乱并聚集在临时仓库的原因，查明情况如下。

福丰公司在上海经营4家面粉厂，两家在租界内，两家在华界。由于目前的战事，华界的工厂停止运营，这些工厂的工人已被雇佣到租界内的两家工厂工作，即莫干山路126号的福丰一厂和澳门路10-12号的兴达福记（Sing Dah Foo Kee）。在这些来自关闭工厂的工人中，一些临时雇员被调配到租界内持续运营的两家工厂，他们的工作主要包括清扫在搬运过程中从袋中掉落的小麦等物。

这80名工人在过去14个月里以上述身份被福丰公司按日雇佣，日薪50美分，按月支付，他们用这笔钱在厂里购买食物，每天花费15美分。

目前这些工人的工作量不足，1937年9月12日，资方决定

pages.en:
1/2.
to suspend them temporarily until the hostilities come to an
end, when they would be taken on again. On being suspended
they were to receive wages for the 12 days which they worked
plus 18 days bonus and $2.00 for transportation to their native
places, however, on being informed of the management's decision
they demanded a bonus of 10 months wages for each man a sum of
approximately $10,000 in all. It may be pointed here, that
casual labourers are usually paid off for the amount of work
done, it being well understood by them, that they are employed
from day to day only.
In this instance however due to the present prevailing
conditions, the management who are in sympathy with the workers
predicament, offered the extra money in order that they should
not be absolutely destitute and in a position if they so wished,
to leave Shanghai to return to their native places.
On the labourers refusing to accept the management's
offer, one Shu Tsah Kiang (許濯江 ), in charge of the personal
dept. and four sub-managers opened negotiations with the labourers
on the 13.9.37, and continued discussions until this a.m. but
the labourers refused to consider any other proposal, but a
bonus of 10 months wages, and on being finally refused, this
a.m. became ugly and commenced to create a disturbance, which
resulted in the management requesting Police assistance. The
labourers on learning that Police were being called, gathered to-
gether in the godown as aforementioned.
On receipt of the aforesaid information, Inspt. Dudley
D.S.I. Chao Ping Kun, D.S. Crossley, Sg.D.S. 269 and the under-
signed proceeded to the godown which is situated in the compound
opposite the offices of the mill with view to reasoning with them.
On entering the godown however the labourers immediately
attacked the party with large logs of wood and a volley of stones
causing the party to beat a hasty retreat. Following this move
on the part of the Police, Inspt. Dudley proceeded to walk up
a short flight of steps leading to the offices with a view of
pages.zh:
1/2。
暂时停雇他们，直到战事结束，届时将重新雇佣他们。在被停雇时，他们将获得工作12天的工资，加上18天的奖金以及2.00美元的回乡路费。然而，在得知资方的决定后，他们要求每人发放相当于10个月工资的奖金，总额约为10,000美元。在此需指出，临时工通常按完成的工作量结算工资，他们非常清楚自己只是按日雇佣。
然而，在这种情况下，由于目前的普遍局势，资方同情工人的困境，提供额外资金，以免他们陷入绝对贫困，并使他们如果有此意愿，能够离开上海返回家乡。
由于工人拒绝接受资方的提议，人事部经理许濯江（Shu Tsah Kiang）和四名副经理于1937年9月13日与工人展开谈判，并持续讨论至今日上午，但工人拒绝考虑除10个月工资奖金以外的任何提议，并在最终被拒绝后，于今天上午变得凶狠并开始制造骚乱，导致资方请求警方协助。工人们在得知警方即将到达后，如前所述聚集在仓库内。
收到上述信息后，督察达德利（Dudley）、副督察长赵秉坤（Chao Ping Kun）、副督察克罗斯利（Crossley）、警佐269号及本人前往位于厂区办公楼对面的仓库，试图与他们讲理。
然而，当进入仓库时，工人们立即用大木头和一阵石头袭击了小队人员，迫使小队人员匆忙撤退。继警方这一举动之后，达德利督察走上通往办公室的几级台阶，打算

pages.en:
1/3.
telephoning to jordon Road Station for the assistance of the
Reserve Unit, his path took him in direct line with the godown
opening facing the office, with the result that he was bombarded
with bricks, logs and lengths of iron, he quickly moved out of
range, but the labourers continued to throw missiles, in endeavour
to strike and break the glass of the french windows fronting the
offices and narrowly missed striking several members of the U.S.
Marine Corps and Chinese office employees of the mill, who were
standing on the verandah fronting the offices. In effort to put
a stop to their rowdy conduct the labourers were called upon by
the Police, to leave the godown, in order that a further discussion
could be made, with view to arriving at a peaceful settlement of
the disturbance.
The labourers replied by challenging the Police, to try
enter to eject them, and at the same time further subjecting the
Police Officers, who had gone to the entrance to address them with
a heavy bombardment of bricks, and afterwards continually threw
various missiles at any person who walked passed the godown
opening.
Meanwhile the Reserve Unit had responded to the call for
assistance. With the arrival of reinforcements, the futility of
their adopting a violent attitude was explained to the labourers
who were again advised to leave the godown, but disregarding all
advice several of them armed with large heavy logs of wood, rushed
to the opening and struck out at Police and members of the Russian
Regiment standing nearby after which they again retreated into the
godown.
Shortly following this exhibition, two of the apparent
ringleaders, namely Tsang Fah Hwa (張法華 ), age 32, Anhwei,
m/worker, and Lieu Shi Zai (劉事財 ), age 23, Shantung, m/worker
both residing the mill quarters, who will be hereafter known as
1st and 2nd accused made a surprise dash from the godown and
gained the office where the 2nd accused brandished a club, whilst
the 1st accused reached for a chair , which he attempted to wield.
pages.zh:
1/3。
打电话给乔丹路（Jordon Road）巡捕房请求后备队支援，他的行进路线正对着面向办公室的仓库开口，结果遭到砖块、木头和铁条的轰炸，他迅速移出射程范围，但工人们继续投掷抛射物，企图击碎并打碎办公室前的法式窗户玻璃，险些击中站在办公室前廊上的几名美国海军陆战队队员和中国职员。为了制止他们的粗暴行为，警察要求工人离开仓库，以便进行进一步讨论，以期和平解决骚乱。
工人回应挑战警察，让他们试着进来驱逐他们，同时向走到入口处与他们讲话的警官猛烈投掷砖块，随后不断向任何走过仓库开口的人投掷各种抛射物。
与此同时，后备队已响应求助呼叫。随着增援部队的到来，向工人解释了采取暴力态度的徒劳无功，并再次劝告他们离开仓库，但他们无视所有劝告，其中几人手持粗大的重木棍，冲向开口，袭击站在附近的警察和俄国团成员，随后又退入仓库。
在这次示威后不久，两名明显的头目，即张法华（Tsang Fah Hwa），32岁，安徽籍，男工，和刘事财（Lieu Shi Zai），23岁，山东籍，男工，均居住在厂区宿舍，下文称为第一和第二被告，突然从仓库冲出并进入办公室，第二被告挥舞着一根棍棒，而第一被告抓起一把椅子，试图挥舞。

pages.en:
1/4.
seeing t.. t danger to individuals and property would result
fro.. their onslaught, Inspt. Dudley, D.S.I. Chao Ping Kun, and
the undersigned closed in on them, and after a lengthy struggle
force had to be used to subdue them. Angered at the seizure of
the 1st and 2nd accused, some of the more daring labourers rush-
ed into the open and after violently attacking 8 members of the
Russian Regiment, hurriedly reentered the godown when effort
was made to seize them.

By this time it was realized that owing to the narrow
openings giving access to the godown, it would be impossible
to enter and drive the labourers out without heavy casualties
on both sides and considerable damage being done to mill
property, therefore it was decided to resort to the use of tear
Gas bombs as a safety precaution. Accordingly Police and the
Russian Regiment concentrated around the entrances to the godown
whilst a party of U.S. Marines, stationed at the mill premises,
acting on the instructions of their senior officer formed a
cordon in front of the mill offices in order to prevent any of
the labourers gaining entry, this move being taken owing to the
fact that a quantity of U.S. Marine Corps, arms and ammunition
were stored therein.

All the necessary arrangements having been completed,
two tear gas bombs, were thrown through openings at each end of
the godown and as soon as the Gas took effect, the labourers
dashed out from all openings in the godown, and commenced to
attack the Police and Russian Regiment with sticks and iron bars
making it necessary for force to be used in seizing and disarming
them.

A number of labourers still remained in the godown and
after a reasonable period had elapsed a third Tear Gas Bomb
was thrown inside, this having the effect of causing them to
abandon their position, these men were unarmed and no force
was used to effect their arrest. Following the affray a check
revealed that 56 of the men had been arrested, others number
unknown, having effected their escape by scrambling to the top
pages.zh:
1/4。
鉴于他们的猛攻将对个人和财产造成危险，达德利督察、副督察长赵秉坤和本人逼近他们，经过长时间的搏斗，不得不使用武力制服他们。由于第一和第二被告被捕，一些更大胆的工人冲进开阔地，在猛烈袭击了8名俄国团成员后，当试图抓捕他们时，又匆忙逃回仓库。

此时人们意识到，由于进入仓库的开口狭窄，如果不造成双方重大伤亡并对工厂财产造成严重破坏，就不可能进入并驱赶工人，因此决定使用催泪瓦斯弹作为安全预防措施。 accordingly，警察和俄国团集中在仓库入口周围，而驻扎在厂区的一队美国海军陆战队根据高级军官的指令，在工厂办公室前形成警戒线，以防止任何工人进入，采取这一行动是因为那里储存了一批美国海军陆战队的武器和弹药。

所有必要安排完成后，两枚催泪瓦斯弹通过仓库两端的开口被投入，瓦斯一旦生效，工人们便从仓库的所有开口冲出，并开始用棍棒和铁条袭击警察和俄国团，使得在抓捕和解除他们武装时必须使用武力。

仍有部分工人留在仓库内，在经过一段合理的时间后，第三枚催泪瓦斯弹被投入内部，这迫使他们放弃阵地，这些人未携带武器，逮捕他们时未使用武力。冲突结束后，经核查，56人被捕，其他人数量不详，他们通过爬至顶部逃脱

pages.en:
1/5.
of the godown, and jumping from the end of the roof over a bamboo
fence into a small enclosure, from where they were able to climb
over a outside wall and absconded.
Of the arrested men 25 who suffered minor injuries and the
effects of tear gas, were conveyed by ... . Ambulance to the St.
Lukes, Lester Chinese and Pau-an Hospitals, where after receiving
treatment, one was detained, the remaining 24 being discharged were
escorted back to the station by Police.
After order had been restored at the mill premises, a small
party of police were detailed to remain on the scene as a precaution
ary measure, whilst the main body of police together with the un-
injured prisoners returned to the station.
Later, Mr. Dien Tung Poo (田登甫 ), manager of the Foo
Foong Flour Mill, accompanied by four other members of the mill
staff called at the station to discuss the method by which the
rioters should be paid wages and bonuses due to them, with the
party was also one Woo Vung Tsoong (胡文鬆 ), this man who was the
ringleader of the other accused had taken it upon himself to act
as their representative in negotiating with the mill management
for a settlement of the dispute on terms dictated by the labourers.
This man who is undoubtedly to a great extent to blame for
inciting the other accused to adopt their violent and defying atti-
tude, has also been placed under arrest and charged with other
accused.

在被捕人员中，有25人受轻伤并受到催泪瓦斯影响，由……救护车送往圣路加医院（St. Lukes）、雷斯特华人医院（Lester Chinese）和保安医院（Pau-an）。在接受治疗后，其中一人被拘留，其余24人被释放，并由警察护送回警局。

在工厂区域秩序恢复后，一小队警察被指派留在现场作为预防措施，而警察主力部队连同未受伤的囚犯返回警局。

稍后，福丰面粉厂（Foo Foong Flour Mill）经理田登甫先生（Mr. Dien Tung Poo）， accompanied by four other members of the mill staff called at the station to discuss the method by which the rioters should be paid wages and bonuses due to them, with the party was also one Woo Vung Tsoong (胡文鬆 ), this man who was the ringleader of the other accused had taken it upon himself to act as their representative in negotiating with the mill management for a settlement of the dispute on terms dictated by the labourers. 此人无疑在很大程度上应对煽动其他被告采取暴力和对抗态度负责，现已被逮捕，并与其它被告一同被起诉。
